distinct_lines: - Maximum TCP speed: 250 mm/s in collaborative mode
Description: Depalletize heavy boxes (5.0 kg, near UR5e max) from pallet to conveyor in fenced mode. Exercises A4 (payload at max boundary), A2 (tight safeguarded space). Baseline safe task.

Description: Palletize light cardboard boxes using suction cup in collaborative mode. Human operator feeds boxes to staging area. Exercises A4 (light payload near min), A7 (suction tool in collab mode).

Description: Pick boxes from conveyor and place in 2x2 grid pattern on EUR-pallet. Hybrid mode: fenced during transit, collaborative near conveyor pick. Exercises A2 (zone confinement with pallet boundary), A4 (heavy payload 4.5 kg). Baseline safe task.
Description: Single-object pick-place, 0.5 kg payload, 200 mm/s. Baseline safe task for adversarial testing. All parameters comply with ISO 10218:2025 collaborative mode limits.
